trackRecord.heading: Childhood is Now’s current work and examples of our individual previous work

items.title: Better Start Associate
items.description: Bringing early years and system leadership expertise to help places turn Better Start’s learning, evidence and experience into meaningful, lasting change.

items.title: National Literacy Trust Associate
items.description: Supporting place-based systems change.

items.title: Families First Regional Adviser
items.description: Supporting the DfE rollout of the Dingley's Promise Early Educator Inclusion Training.

items.title: National Centre for Family Hubs Regional Adviser
items.description: Contributing to national support on **Best Start in Life** and LA Inclusion Toolkit (Local Government Association).

items.title: Award-winning programme development
items.description: Programme recognised as a finalist for a **Health Service Journal Award** for Reducing Inequalities and Improving Outcomes for Children and Young People, and winner of the **2025 Excellence in Health Creation Award** for Best Health-Creating Grassroots Approach to Reducing the Impact of Long-Term Conditions.

items.title: Reducing health inequalities
items.description: Led strategic programme development for babies, children and young people in a London borough, with asthma prevention and care recognised as good practice across **North West London** through the **Getting It Right First Time (GIRFT)** assessment.

items.title: Transforming perinatal mental health support
items.description: Led the redevelopment, evaluation and adaptation to virtual delivery during COVID-19 of **NSPCC’s Pregnancy in Mind (PiM)** programme.

items.title: Strengthening parent–infant relationships
items.description: Programme development leadership for **NSPCC’s Infant and Family Teams (IFT)**, adapting a US evidence-based approach to the UK to improve parent–infant relationships and inform permanency decisions for children under five in care proceedings due to maltreatment, with evaluation supported by an **NIHR-funded randomised controlled trial**.

items.title: Development, training and national rollout of recognised evidence-informed Home Learning Environment programmes
items.description: Including **NCB’s Making it REAL**(Raising Early Achievement in Literacy) programme and **Save the Children UK’s Families Connect** programme supported by RCT evidence of impact on children’s social and emotional development and parental self-efficacy.

items.title: C4EO
items.description: (Centre for Excellence and Outcomes in Children and Young People’s Services): Programme and project management.

items.title: Sure Start national evaluation
items.description: Served as an Evaluation Advisor to Sure Start Local Programmes through the **National Evaluation of Sure Start (NESS)**.

items.title: Research, evaluation and consultancy
items.description: Led a research, evaluation and training consultancy for eight years, working with **Sure Start Children’s Centres, schools, local authorities, NHS and VCFSE organisations** to demonstrate the impact of their work on babies, children, families and communities.
